description: Instances for the ORTEC VeRoLog Solver Challenge of 2016 to 2017, a routing problem that redistributes scarce equipment between customers within time windows, released in sets from the early test instances to the hidden ones.
name: VeRoLog 2016-2017 scarce-equipment pickup and delivery instances
